when.test: scope != null and scope.restricted() and scope.laboratoryIds != null and !scope.laboratoryIds.isEmpty()

mapper.select: select from lab_inspection_plan p where p.id=#{planId} and p.del_flag='0'
select from lab_inspection_plan p where p.id=#{planId} and p.del_flag='0' for update

select from lab_inspection_plan p where p.del_flag='0'
and p.status=#{status} and p.plan_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by p.create_time desc
select from lab_inspection_plan p where p.status='ENABLED' and p.next_run_at <=#{now} and p.del_flag='0' order by p.next_run_at,p.id limit #{batchSize} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update lab_inspection_plan set plan_name=#{plan.planName},laboratory_id=#{plan.laboratoryId}, frequency_type=#{plan.frequencyType},interval_value=#{plan.intervalValue},execute_time=#{plan.executeTime}, day_of_week=#{plan.dayOfWeek},day_of_month=#{plan.dayOfMonth},next_run_at=#{plan.nextRunAt}, owner_id=#{plan.ownerId},deadline_rule=#{plan.deadlineRule},deadline_offset_minutes=#{plan.deadlineOffsetMinutes}, update_by=#{plan.updateBy},update_time=#{plan.updateTime},version=version+1 where id=#{plan.id} and version=#{expectedVersion} and status='DISABLED' and del_flag='0'
update lab_inspection_plan set status=#{target},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 where id=#{planId} and status=#{expected} and del_flag='0'

update lab_inspection_plan set next_run_at=#{nextRun},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 where id=#{planId} and next_run_at=#{expectedNextRun} and status='ENABLED' and del_flag='0'
